subject.title: fix(gateway): re-check session runtime model against current agent defaults after hot-reload

question: Should persisted modelProvider/model without override fields be treated as disposable default cache, or must legacy/runtime-only session model selections continue to win over current agent defaults?
rationale: The PR fixes the reported stale default cache by broadening resolver behavior, but that also changes upgrade behavior for existing stored session model state that current docs treat as manual-review user or legacy state.

options.title: Preserve runtime-only pins before merge
options.body: Require the PR to distinguish default-derived reset cache from legacy/runtime-only model selections and add regression coverage for both paths.

options.title: Accept disposable runtime cache
options.body: Merge only if maintainers explicitly decide no-override modelProvider/model rows are not user selections and can be re-resolved from current defaults on upgrade.

options.title: Pause for migration design
options.body: Hold the PR while a marker or doctor migration is designed for pre-existing stale default cache rows.

recommendation.title: Preserve runtime-only pins before merge
recommendation.body: Require the PR to distinguish default-derived reset cache from legacy/runtime-only model selections and add regression coverage for both paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the recent current-main gateway/session snapshot and have adjacent runtime model-cache review history, making them the best visible routing owner for the compatibility choice.
